summaryBox.title: E2 Regioselectivity & Stereochemistry
summaryBox.takeaway: Saytzeff Rule (more substituted alkene) with alc. KOH; Hofmann Rule (less substituted alkene) with bulky t-BuOK. Requires anti-periplanar geometry.

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
ELIMINATION REGIOSELECTIVITY:

• Saytzeff (Zaitsev) Rule: Unhindered base (alc. KOH / EtO⁻) ──► More substituted alkene (2-butene 81% major).
• Hofmann Rule: Bulky base (t-BuOK) ──► Less substituted alkene (1-butene major).
• Stereochemistry: E2 requires anti-periplanar arrangement of α-H and β-X (180° dihedral angle).
conceptBreakdown.content: Dehydrohalogenation of alkyl halides follows an E2 concerted elimination requiring an anti-periplanar conformation between the departing halogen and $\beta$-hydrogen.

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
10 NEST HALOALKANES & HALOARENES TRAPS SUMMARY

1. Neopentyl bromide (1°) is extremely inert to S_N2 due to t-butyl steric hindrance.
2. S_N1 yields Racemization with partial inversion (100% inversion is S_N2).
3. CCl₄ has zero net dipole moment (μ = 0) due to tetrahedral symmetry.
4. Chlorobenzene is inert to room temperature S_N2.
5. Propan-1-ol gives a NEGATIVE iodoform test; Propan-2-ol gives a positive test.
6. Polar protic solvents inhibit S_N2 by solvating nucleophiles; Polar Aprotic favor S_N2.
7. DDT is non-biodegradable and lipophilic, biomagnifying to 25 ppm in birds.
8. Meisenheimer complex formed in S_NAr is a CARBANION σ-complex (not carbocation).
9. Glycerol is purified by vacuum distillation; aniline by steam distillation.
10. A racemic mixture is an equimolar (1:1) d/l mixture and is OPTICALLY INACTIVE (α = 0).
